decision: Whether to scope an evidence-first harness coverage extension before designing new controls or city overlays.
does_not_prove: A single repository is not a representative cross-language calibration corpus.
Static configuration is not observed local or cloud enforcement, secure MCP behavior, extension installation or skill trust.
Missing dedicated catalog titles do not prove every possible heuristic is absent.
This discovery does not fix the known redaction defect, implement new checks, change scores or connect city overlays.
The spike is not the mandatory later design prototype.

next.action: Use this coverage inventory and its gaps to clarify the evidence contract in the spec workflow, starting with wayfinder; do not implement overlays yet.

open_questions.lean: Keep the first audit repository-scoped; accept separately approved redacted imports later.
